build_NetworkCIFAR: build a NetworkCIFAR NAS model with given genotype, channels, layers, and num_classes for CIFAR-10
create_Cell: create a Cell module with genotype-driven normal or reduction operations for neural architecture search
create_AuxiliaryHeadCIFAR: create an AuxiliaryHeadCIFAR classification head for CIFAR training with auxiliary loss
run_drop_path: run the drop_path function to apply stochastic depth regularization to a tensor during training
review_Cell_forward: review the Cell forward pass that applies genotype operations with drop_path and concatenates states
